title: Departure ordering
required_work: Trace the merged cashout eviction outcome through leave, kick, sit-out expiry and shutdown; prove departure cannot precede a confirmed disposition.
acceptance: Reject/timeout/lost-response and concurrent leave/kick tests; normal deployed engine runs the tested commit.

title: Cashout business identity
required_work: Bind one durable operation ID to player, club, table, seat generation, currency and amount across retries.
acceptance: Same request returns the original receipt; changed payload is rejected; duplicate requests never credit twice.

title: Seat and escrow ownership
required_work: Trace stack, committed bets, side pots and escrow at every departure boundary.
acceptance: Conservation before and after departure with an active hand, all-in, disconnect and seat reuse.

title: Release provenance
required_work: Map each scoped fix to migration, merged source, test evidence and actual adopted runtime.
acceptance: Separate database, static frontend and engine versions; no pending adoption marked complete.

title: Original requirement register
required_work: Recover the original 216-requirement register and cross-map its actual identifiers.
acceptance: Every original requirement has evidence or an explicit open status; do not reconstruct invented IDs.

title: Obsolete candidate changes
required_work: Keep superseded hand-commit and dedicated rebuy-receipt branches out of deployment.
acceptance: Deployment ancestry excludes superseded alternatives and uses the shared canonical protocols.

title: Legal action authority
required_work: Review server legality for check, call, bet, raise, fold and all-in for every supported variant.
acceptance: Adversarial clients cannot act out of turn, spend beyond stack or bypass betting limits.

title: Short all-in reopening
required_work: Verify minimum raise and reopening rights across multiple short all-ins.
acceptance: Table-driven rule examples cover intervening action and cumulative raises.

title: Side pots and eligibility
required_work: Review contribution grouping, folded players, refunds of unmatched bets and zero-stack seats.
acceptance: Independent expected allocations balance exactly for multiway all-ins and folds.

title: Split and odd-chip allocation
required_work: Review ties, high-low qualification, multiple boards and odd-chip priority.
acceptance: Exact smallest-unit conservation; deterministic rule-correct allocation on every board.

title: Blinds and position
required_work: Review heads-up transitions, dead buttons, missed blinds, straddles and new seats.
acceptance: Position and blind obligations remain correct through departures and table merges.

title: Variant rule matrix
required_work: Enumerate configured variants and trace evaluator, deck and betting rules per variant.
acceptance: Every selectable variant has independent evaluation vectors and full hand tests.

title: RNG and hidden information
required_work: Review shuffle entropy, deck uniqueness, server ownership and card access across logs, sockets and history.
acceptance: No duplicate cards, predictable client influence or unauthorized hole-card/deck disclosure.

title: Showdown and muck
required_work: Review automatic reveal, winner disclosure, muck choices and history visibility.
acceptance: UI and server agree on visibility; privileged and spectator paths cannot leak private cards.

title: Bomb pots and runouts
required_work: Review bomb-pot scheduling, mandatory contributions, multi-board settlement and cancellation.
acceptance: Collection and awards remain balanced across errors and table population changes.

title: Decision timers
required_work: Review timeout actions, time banks and clock authority through reconnect and maintenance.
acceptance: One authoritative action occurs at deadline; stale timers cannot act on a new hand.

title: Entry and re-entry
required_work: Trace registration, late registration, rebuy and addon through wallet debit, prize allocation and seat creation.
acceptance: Atomic failure injection and concurrent retry tests prove one funded entry per operation.

title: Bounty PKO accounting
required_work: Trace entry bounty split, knockout allocation, progressive carry and final winner disposition.
acceptance: Prize, fee and bounty liabilities reconcile algebraically within each committed operation.

title: Mystery bounty commitments
required_work: Review funded award inventory, eligibility, random draw, reveal and retry identity.
acceptance: One funded award per eligible draw; retries cannot reroll or consume multiple awards.

title: Payout plan authority
required_work: Review current canonical payout plan, rank finalization and idempotent awards; recheck concurrent fixes before opening defects.
acceptance: No partial completion; each recipient and retained liability matches the immutable approved plan.

title: Disabled tournament safeguards
required_work: Explain all seven disabled triggers and prove replacement invariants and authorized retirement.
acceptance: Each disabled guard has replacement evidence or a tested source correction; no blind re-enabling.

title: Deals and final table completion
required_work: Review deal acceptance, participant binding, chip-based calculations and post-deal completion.
acceptance: All required consents match one versioned plan; no double payout or mutable finalized pool.

title: Guarantees and overlays
required_work: Review funding source, fee separation, minimum entries and guarantee changes.
acceptance: Every overlay is funded and journaled; published commitments cannot silently change.

title: Spin multiplier and prizes
required_work: Review draw commitment, multiplier persistence, funding and restart behavior.
acceptance: A started game has one funded immutable prize; retry and outage cannot redraw.

title: Tournament seating and clocks
required_work: Review balancing, table merges, breaks, blind levels, heads-up transitions and duplicate seats.
acceptance: Concurrent moves preserve one seat per entry and one authoritative tournament clock.

title: Satellite awards and ticket liabilities
required_work: Review the hardened funding path plus ticket mint, ownership, redemption and award completion.
acceptance: Tickets and underlying liabilities are created/redeemed once with recipient and tournament binding.

title: Unregister, cancellation and outage
required_work: Review approved pre-start unregister and common origin-wallet refund; inspect cancellation and interrupted-event policy.
acceptance: Refunds return once to the proper origin; no invented satellite refund subsystem.

title: Tournament client wiring
required_work: Exercise all create/edit/register/rebuy/addon/deal/results pages and permission states.
acceptance: Displayed options, server acceptance and persisted state agree for MTT, SNG and Spins.

title: Legacy agent self-transfer routing
required_work: Replace active legacy wallet-pool self-transfer with club-scoped canonical self-stake after identity and ownership mapping.
acceptance: Both AgentPortalPage and AgentFinancialPortal use agents.user_id/club identity correctly and canonical balances; no guessed historical balance migration.

title: Agent transfer retry identity
required_work: Move AgentService.transferToPlayer operation creation to the durable business intent and validate finite amount and strict receipt.
acceptance: Lost response, reload and repeated submit reuse the same key; altered payload and malformed success cannot credit.

title: Global wallet writer inventory
required_work: Trace every balance-writing RPC, trigger, service, admin script and indirect helper to an authorized journal transaction.
acceptance: No unregistered balance write or independently committed journal leg remains.

title: Accounting transaction primitive
required_work: Verify debit, credit, journal, receipt and state transition commit together with conservation constraints.
acceptance: Injected failure at each statement leaves no partial state; valid retry returns the original result.

title: Precision and limits
required_work: Review smallest units, numeric scale, rounding, bounds, NaN/infinity and JSON conversions per asset.
acceptance: No floating-point loss, negative authorization bypass, overflow or cross-asset balancing.

title: Cashier send and take-back
required_work: Trace player, agent, club and union send/recall paths including roles and insufficient funds.
acceptance: Authorized parties only; serialized competing spends cannot overdraw or take another tenant's funds.

title: Cashout approvals and reversals
required_work: Review requests, approvals, denial, cancellation and external settlement evidence.
acceptance: One legal state transition and one financial disposition; external uncertainty does not cause duplicate payment.

title: Wallet type and tenant boundary
required_work: Review player, business, promo, treasury and legacy global pools for every caller.
acceptance: All reads and writes agree on owner, club, asset and account purpose; retired paths are explicit.

title: Ticket sending and redemption
required_work: Review issue, send, take-back, expiration, redemption and duplicate-use protection.
acceptance: Ownership transitions and liabilities are atomic and payload-bound; concurrent redemption succeeds once.

title: Chip mint and burn
required_work: Review authorized issuance, source account, supply effects and audit actor.
acceptance: Every issuance or destruction has an explicit balanced journal and correct authorization.

title: Diamond economy
required_work: Trace purchase, grant, spend, refund, gifting and chip conversion where supported.
acceptance: Diamond and chip ledgers remain separately balanced; retries cannot repeat grants or conversion.

title: Cashier UI receipts
required_work: Review pending, rejected and confirmed states and history deduplication on all cashier controls.
acceptance: UI never announces success before an authoritative matching receipt; refresh reproduces the same outcome.

title: Rake calculation and caps
required_work: Review all game-type rates, caps, eligibility, no-flop rules and smallest-unit rounding against approved configuration.
acceptance: Independent calculation vectors cover boundary pots and all supported table rules without changing approved economics.

title: Union-to-club attribution
required_work: Trace collected rake, owning union/club and settlement period to actual treasury credits.
acceptance: Each hand belongs to one correct scope and period; no duplicate distribution or orphan liability.

title: Agent and player rake shares
required_work: Trace club-to-agent hierarchy, subagents and player rakeback including hierarchy changes.
acceptance: Approved rates apply to immutable earning context; total distributions do not exceed their funded basis.

title: Weighted attribution versus payment
required_work: Separate contribution statistics and rewards attribution from actual rake and cash credits.
acceptance: Weighted statistics cannot mint funds or generate an additional financial credit.

title: BBJ main, backup and promo split
required_work: Review every collection path with main fixed at 50%; recover approved backup/promo configuration and rounding policy.
acceptance: All three legs commit together and sum to collection; no assumed 25/25 split.

title: BBJ payout and replenishment
required_work: Review eligibility, claim approval, main payout, backup transfer and post-win pool state.
acceptance: One funded award; replenishment is a traceable transfer and cannot duplicate on retry.

title: BBJ reporting identity
required_work: Review pool/club/union/hand labels, bucket identity and time-window reports.
acceptance: Reports reproduce all three correctly labeled legs, including the completed original incident correction.

title: Promo credits and redemption
required_work: Review allocations, accrual, grant, expiry and spend/refund rules.
acceptance: Promo liabilities and funding remain explicit; retries and expired eligibility cannot create free chips.

title: Period close and settlement
required_work: Review union treasury close, overlapping periods, late events and repeated settlement.
acceptance: No event is omitted or paid twice; immutable period ownership and journal evidence survive retry.

title: Retire repair dependencies
required_work: Work through all 32 existing allowlist entries after their source invariants are proven.
acceptance: Allowlist only shrinks; retire obsolete repair jobs without replacing them with renamed watchers.

title: Security-definer RPC review
required_work: Review bodies, fixed search paths, caller checks and grants for 426 observed definer overloads.
acceptance: Untrusted callers cannot impersonate owners, choose unauthorized tenants or invoke privileged helpers.

title: Anonymous callable RPCs
required_work: Classify and adversarially test the 21 observed anon-executable overloads.
acceptance: Public exposure is intentional and minimum-privilege; catalog exposure alone is not labeled an exploit.

title: RLS policy correctness
required_work: Review all policies and role combinations on the 179 observed relations plus indirect dependencies.
acceptance: Cross-tenant read/write attempts fail; service-role paths independently enforce business authorization.

title: Session and account lifecycle
required_work: Review sign-in, refresh, logout, revocation, role changes and account deletion.
acceptance: Revoked sessions and stale role caches cannot retain sensitive access.

title: Endpoint and socket authorization
required_work: Trace all 28 server router branches plus dynamic/API/socket entrypoints.
acceptance: Every command authenticates scope, actor and current authority; no trusted client financial fields.

title: Secret and deployment configuration
required_work: Review documented .env names and deployment paths without printing values; verify Hetzner-only Club Arena publication.
acceptance: Secrets remain server-only; no browser bundles, logs or reports disclose credentials.

title: Storage authorization
required_work: Trace assets, club-assets and images candidates through bucket policies and signed URLs.
acceptance: Upload/read/delete authorization, file validation and object ownership are tested.

title: Abuse and request validation
required_work: Review schema bounds, rate limits, CSRF/CORS and replay/duplicate handling where applicable.
acceptance: Malformed or abusive requests fail without corrupting state or starving unrelated tables.

title: Incomplete cash-hand recovery
required_work: Replace snapshot completion-only recovery with an authoritative interrupted-hand state protocol.
acceptance: Restart restores or deterministically resolves the accepted hand without losing bets, changing cards or guessing refunds.

title: Snapshot completion before settlement
required_work: Move durable completion behind authoritative hand settlement and disposition evidence.
acceptance: Crash at every boundary cannot mark an unsettled hand complete or commit its financial effects twice.

title: Accepted action durability
required_work: Trace action acceptance, persistence, sequence numbers and response ordering.
acceptance: Acknowledged action survives process loss; replay neither omits nor duplicates an action.

title: Lease and stale owner fencing
required_work: Review all hand and table writers against the shared lease and canonical commit protocol.
acceptance: Old engine owners cannot settle or mutate after ownership changes.

title: Realtime sequence and resubscription
required_work: Review socket/subscription reconnect, duplicates, gaps and ordering.
acceptance: Clients converge on authoritative state after dropped, reordered and repeated events.

title: Mobile and PWA resume
required_work: Review sleep, background, network switch, multiple tabs and cached releases.
acceptance: Resume restores current hand and wallet state without resubmitting a financial intent.

title: Maintenance freeze and thaw
required_work: Review scheduled lifecycle, in-flight transactions and normal engine version adoption.
acceptance: No guard bypass or forced restart; operations are either committed or safely rejected during the boundary.

title: External effect protocol
required_work: Identify effects outside the database and use durable intent plus destination idempotency where available.
acceptance: Lost responses cannot produce duplicate external payouts; do not claim a database transaction controls external networks.

title: Lobby listings and filters
required_work: Review club/union visibility, stakes, variants, search, pagination and stale occupancy.
acceptance: Filters and counts match authorized live data across refresh and subscription loss.

title: Seat claims and reservations
required_work: Review simultaneous seat joins, reservation expiry and seat generation.
acceptance: One occupant per seat and one authorized funded buy-in; expired claims cannot steal new seats.

title: Waitlists and auto-seat
required_work: Review queue fairness, claim acceptance, timeout and funding handoff.
acceptance: A claim is consumed once and cannot bypass club membership or wallet checks.

title: Buy-in, top-up and rebuy wiring
required_work: Trace manual and automatic funding while seated and between hands.
acceptance: One escrow transfer per accepted intent; no stack change occurs before the confirmed transaction.

title: Multi-table navigation
required_work: Review table switching, simultaneous sessions, active-table identity and wallet refresh.
acceptance: Actions and financial confirmations always target the intended table and seat.

title: Warm tables and lifecycle
required_work: Review creation, idle shutdown, occupancy authority and restart attachment.
acceptance: Tables do not accept play without an authoritative engine; no ghost seats or duplicate owners.

title: Spectator and player views
required_work: Review watch/join transitions and private/public payload boundaries.
acceptance: Spectators see only public data and cannot issue player-only commands.

title: Join and leave feedback
required_work: Review full tables, insufficient funds, membership rejection and interrupted requests.
acceptance: Every control reports a clear durable outcome without trapping a reservation or presenting false success.

title: Balance reconstruction
required_work: Review event time, recording time, account identity and immutable corrections.
acceptance: Balances at a cutoff are reproducible from valid ledger semantics; journal-only corrections are explicit.

title: Incident semantics
required_work: Separate true imbalance, execution failure, missing evidence and delayed reads in incident classification.
acceptance: Zero discrepancy is not silently treated as proof of health or corruption; resolution cites exact evidence.

title: Hand and tournament history
required_work: Review completeness, pagination, participants, awards and visibility.
acceptance: History matches authoritative outcomes and never leaks hidden information.

title: Player, agent and club statistics
required_work: Review denominators, weighted attribution, currencies, timezone and period boundaries.
acceptance: Reports match independently derived fixtures and distinguish statistics from cash credits.

title: Configuration authority
required_work: Trace every editable rate, cap, timer, prize and rule from UI to server/database authority.
acceptance: One approved effective configuration applies at the right boundary; clients cannot override it.

title: Exports and accounting statements
required_work: Review filters, totals, precision, timezone and spreadsheet formula escaping.
acceptance: Exports match the same scoped query and totals as the UI with safe cell content.

title: Cache invalidation
required_work: Review all report and balance caches after transactions, role changes and reconnect.
acceptance: Read-after-confirmation displays the committed version and cannot combine incompatible snapshots.

title: Migration and live-body drift
required_work: Compare applicable migration history, live signatures, function bodies and ACLs.
acceptance: Historical declarations are not mistaken for active code; each live difference has provenance.

title: Club and union governance
required_work: Review membership, invitations, ownership transfer, suspension and delegated roles.
acceptance: Only current authorized actors can change scope or transact; role changes preserve historical attribution.

title: Player protection controls
required_work: Inventory existing limits, exclusions, breaks and support controls; review agreed product policy.
acceptance: Enforced server state survives alternate entry routes and reconnect; policy gaps are documented.

title: Dispute and support evidence
required_work: Review hand/transaction lookup, case references and correction authorization.
acceptance: Support can explain an outcome from immutable evidence without unaudited balance editing.

title: Integrity investigations
required_work: Review existing reporting, suspicious activity evidence and privileged access.
acceptance: Evidence access is scoped, logged and separated from unauthorized outcome manipulation.

title: Notifications and social features
required_work: Review recipients, unread state, retries, moderation and deep links.
acceptance: No tenant or private-data leak; repeated delivery cannot repeat a financial action.

title: Admin and operational tools
required_work: Review every script, manual RPC and privileged page that changes economic state.
acceptance: All write doors use the same authorization and atomic ledger invariants as normal product flows.

title: Settings and lifecycle
required_work: Review club setup, archival, configuration changes and account relationships.
acceptance: Lifecycle operations cannot orphan balances, tickets, tables or unsettled liabilities.

title: All 125 page and tab files
required_work: Use the page register as the mandatory per-file checklist, including nested tabs and development surfaces.
acceptance: Every row has tested roles, routes, states, dependencies and evidence or an explicit exclusion.

title: All route declarations
required_work: Resolve 168 discovered Route declarations, including 134 in App, and dynamic/redirect/layout behavior.
acceptance: Direct load, back/forward, refresh, invalid ID and unauthorized route tests cover each production destination.

title: All discovered controls
required_work: Review 3,833 interactive JSX candidates and find interactions created dynamically or outside JSX.
acceptance: Every production control has correct wiring, disabled/loading/error/success states and keyboard behavior.

title: Responsive layout
required_work: Review desktop, narrow mobile, rotation, zoom, safe areas and overlapping navigation/modals.
acceptance: Critical actions and amounts remain visible and usable without unintended horizontal clipping.

title: Accessibility
required_work: Review keyboard order, focus return, labels, contrast, announcements and error prevention.
acceptance: WCAG 2.2 AA-oriented checks include actual assistive-technology testing of critical financial flows.

title: Store, VIP and rewards
required_work: Review product eligibility, purchase, entitlement, expiry, redemption and refund.
acceptance: Displayed price matches the committed debit; entitlement and accounting share a durable operation.

title: Assets and content
required_work: Review indexed images, icons, fonts, text, broken links and placeholder content.
acceptance: No broken assets, misleading controls or production-only placeholder states.

title: State completeness
required_work: Review empty, loading, timeout, offline, denied, expired and partially populated page states.
acceptance: Users can recover without repeating an uncertain transaction or losing context.

title: Realtime visual correctness
required_work: Review hand animations, balances, badges, notifications and stale component closures.
acceptance: Visual transitions reflect authoritative sequence and never imply an uncommitted financial result.

title: Dead and duplicate surfaces
required_work: Classify archives, previews, unreachable pages and duplicated service/UI implementations.
acceptance: Production surface is explicit; removal or consolidation follows verified usage and does not silently remove features.

title: Financial concurrency suite
required_work: Build shared property and failure-injection tests for every financial operation family.
acceptance: Conservation, isolation, authorization and payload-bound idempotency hold under competing and interrupted operations.

title: Database contention and queries
required_work: Review transaction duration, lock order, indexes, plans and hot-account contention.
acceptance: Measured peak-load tests meet agreed latency budgets without partial commits or unbounded deadlock retries.

title: Runtime and client load
required_work: Measure tables, sockets, memory, rendering, network volume and bundle size.
acceptance: Agreed capacity and responsiveness budgets pass with representative simultaneous games and users.

title: Backup and restore proof
required_work: Review database/WAL backups, restore procedures, secrets and ledger evidence continuity.
acceptance: An isolated restore meets agreed recovery objectives and verifies journals and outstanding liabilities.

title: Migration and rollback safety
required_work: Review forward compatibility, grants, live definitions and old/new client coexistence.
acceptance: Normal releases preserve invariants throughout deployment; rollback cannot revive retired unsafe writers.

title: Hetzner publication verification
required_work: Verify documented push path, CI, static origin, public route and scheduled engine adoption separately.
acceptance: Published versions match approved commits and required tests; no manual production bypass.

title: Dependency and supply-chain review
required_work: Review lockfiles, build actions, server packages and known advisories using current primary sources.
acceptance: Applicable vulnerabilities and unsupported components have validated fixes or explicit outstanding records.

title: Integration boundary coverage
required_work: Trace dynamic RPCs, indirect helpers, cron, storage and external callbacks missing from the literal-source catalog.
acceptance: Every runtime write entrypoint has an owner, authorization check, invariant and test evidence.

title: CI regression gates
required_work: Enforce critical negative/concurrency tests and prevent silent reintroduction of legacy writers or repair jobs.
acceptance: A deliberately broken invariant fails CI; skipped browser/deployment suites are never reported as passed.

title: Final cross-phase acceptance
required_work: Close each item only after source review, meaningful tests, merged code and relevant runtime evidence.
acceptance: No blanket '100% safe forever' claim; every open or untested item remains visible with ownership.

title: Historical incident completeness
required_work: Review every unresolved incident and closures without transaction-level proof; distinguish imbalance, missing journals and reporting errors.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Complete financial entrypoint coverage
required_work: Close all indirect helper, scheduled job, administrative script, external callback and dynamic-call coverage; Phase 1 establishes the expanded catalog only.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Account lifecycle accounting
required_work: Prove disposition of chips, tickets, rakeback and prizes on member departure, upline changes, club/union changes, suspension and deletion.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Effective-date rules
required_work: Bind immutable rates, hierarchy and BBJ configuration to the earning event; later changes cannot silently reprice earlier obligations.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Smallest-unit allocation
required_work: Define and independently test rounding-remainder ownership for all split operations; apply checks also in phases 2, 4 and 6.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Cross-system failure boundaries
required_work: Test committed operation followed by response loss, engine crash, client disconnect or failed notification; retry returns its original outcome.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Release compatibility
required_work: Prove old clients, service workers and engines cannot use retired financial paths through rollout or rollback.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Independent accounting oracle
required_work: Every financial phase compares production outcomes to separately derived expected allocations, not a copy of production arithmetic.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.

title: Evidence-based completion
required_work: Every phase and closed item must cite owner, exact source, tests, deployed version and acceptance evidence.
acceptance: Source evidence, independent negative/concurrency/recovery tests and relevant deployed behavior recorded before closure.
